title: Podcast starter page front matter
description: The front matter of a page of the podcast site: every Markdown file outside _posts/.

author.description: The host of the page: a key of _data/authors.yml.

cta_text.description: The label of the call-to-action button on the home page.

cta_url.description: Where the call-to-action button on the home page goes.

description.description: One sentence for search results and link previews.

lang.description: The language of the page, as a BCP 47 tag. Defaults to the language of the site.

layout.description: The layout that renders the page: page, home, archive, tags, author, or not-found.

nav_order.description: The order of the page in the generated navigation.

permalink.description: The address of the page, when it is not the one the file name gives it.

published.description: false leaves the page out of the build. AGENTS.md uses it to stay out of the site.

search.description: false leaves the page out of the search index.

sitemap.description: false leaves the page out of sitemap.xml.

tags.description: The topics of the page, shown on the tags page.

title.description: The title of the page, shown in the heading and in the browser tab.

variant.description: How the home page is laid out. blog lists every episode.
